<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="FRPtLgAMxpuKAKLBK61r"> <mxGraphModel dx="2706" dy="1401" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml SystemArchitecture

skinparam componentStyle rectangle
left to right direction

actor Teacher

package \"Frontend (React + Vite)\" {

 component \"Upload Panel\" as UploadPanel
 component \"Progress Stream\n(SSE)\" as ProgressStream
 component \"Stage Workspace\" as StageWorkspace
 component \"Export Menu\" as ExportMenu

}

package \"Backend (FastAPI)\" {

 component \"routers.py\n(API Gateway)\" as Routers
 component \"orchestrator.py\" as Orchestrator
 component \"stages_extraction.py\" as StagesExtraction
 component \"stages_generation.py\" as StagesGeneration
 component \"validator.py\" as Validator
 component \"publisher.py\" as Publisher
 component \"llm_client.py\" as LLMClient
 component \"vector_store.py\" as VectorStore
 component \"document_intelligence.py\" as DocIntel

}

database \"SQLite

documents
stage_outputs
chat_messages
embedding_chunks
pipeline_runs\" as DB

cloud \"Ollama\n(Local / Cloud)\nLLM\" as Ollama
cloud \"Tavily\n(Optional Search)\" as Tavily
cloud \"Hugging Face Hub\nEmbedding Model Download\" as HF

'========================
' User Interaction
'========================

Teacher --> UploadPanel
Teacher --> StageWorkspace

UploadPanel --> Routers : REST\nMultipart Upload
ProgressStream --> Routers : SSE
StageWorkspace --> Routers : REST\nGenerate / Chat / Approve / Publish
ExportMenu --> Routers : REST\nExport

'========================
' Backend Flow
'========================

Routers --> Orchestrator
Routers --> StagesGeneration
Routers --> Validator
Routers --> Publisher

Orchestrator --> DocIntel
Orchestrator --> StagesExtraction
Orchestrator --> VectorStore
Orchestrator --> DB

StagesExtraction --> LLMClient
StagesGeneration --> LLMClient
Validator --> VectorStore

'========================
' External Services
'========================

LLMClient --> Ollama : Chat / Generation
LLMClient --> Tavily : Pedagogy Search (Optional)

VectorStore --> HF : Download Embedding Model\n(First Boot)
VectorStore --> DB

Routers --> DB

@enduml",
